name: jobs-assistant-browser-adapter
description: Puppeteer browser adapter for jobs-assistant guarded autofill

scripts.puppeteer-verify: RUN_PUPPETEER_INTEGRATION=1 RUN_PUPPETEER_HEADED_SMOKE=1 uv run --frozen --extra dev python -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_puppeteer_adapter.py -k 'not test_headed_review_survives_parent_and_closes_from_tab and not test_headed_input_submit_handoff_requires_trusted_gesture'
